purpose: Separate prompt-ID identification from the response magnitude transferred to unknown nodes by adding one selected-prompt anchor on an influential target.

arms.low: Frozen P11: one low-degree node identifies prompt ID and also supplies the initial unknown-node response magnitude.
arms.anchor: Use the same low node and prompt 1/2/3 sequence for identification. If the selected prompt response is positive, request one selected-prompt communication on the highest public component-influence untouched node satisfying the original probe eligibility.

anchor.candidate: A single Python-generated legal communication candidate selected by the injected LLM, with one action per host step.
anchor.success_update: After a successful uncensored anchor, estimate unknown-node response only from distinct post-calibration selected-prompt first-equivalent observations; exclude the low identification probe magnitude. Concrete observed nodes retain their own value.
anchor.fallback: Failure, clipping, no legal anchor target, or nonpositive selected prompt retains frozen P11 behavior and never updates the anchor prior.

attribution_limit: This is a compound anchor-plus-transfer-prior intervention, not a pure selector effect. Report structure/communication reordering and persuasion later erased by shielding.
gate: anchor-minus-low symmetric mean greater than 1 terminal unit
at least four of six family means are nonnegative
minimum paired anchor-minus-low delta is at least -10
all cases correctly identify the best prompt with zero action/planning/runtime failures and ordinary successful calibration cost at most 8
decision: Passing is development screening only. Do not combine with the 0.9 unknown-prior discount and do not open repetitions 1401-1403.
